title: Illyria Pty Limited and Consolidated Press Holdings Limited - proposed acquisition of Consolidated Media Holdings Limited
acquirers: Illyria Pty Limited and Consolidated Press Holdings Limited

timeline.event: The ACCC began monitoring the proposal while awaiting a submission from the parties.
ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Following the announcement to the ASX made by CMH on 6 March 2008, the ACCC has paused its assessment of the proposal pending receipt of further information regarding the status of the proposal.
CMH announced to the ASX that the proposal had been withdrawn. ACCC review concluded with no decision made.
